entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please have your order number ready.
Yeah, yeah, I need to make a return. Order number 775-B.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with...
Look, I don't have a lot of time. Can I return these shoes or not? It's a simple question.
Of course. I've pulled up your order for the road cycling shoes. So I can process this correctly, what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't work for me. I adjusted the cleats, went on one ride, and got painful blisters. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear that the fit wasn't right. That can definitely be frustrating. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I've checked the policy. It looks like your order was delivered 34 days ago. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can definitely process this for you.
Great. So you'll email me a shipping label?
Yes, I'm generating that for you right now. You'll receive an email with a prepaid return label shortly. Just place the cycling shoes back in the box and attach the label.
And the refund will go back to my card?
Correct. As soon as our warehouse receives and inspects the item, your full refund will be processed to the original payment method. That usually takes 3 to 5 business days after we get the package.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
